description: A comment that mentions an Actor (agent → Priya, Priya → agent) shows no 'Notified …' chip or any delivery state in the task panel, so the person cannot tell whether the mention reached anyone or was acknowledged.
expected: A small 'Notified Priya Raman' / 'Delivered' cue on mention comments, as the story describes.
actual: Only the highlighted handle text; no notification or delivery state anywhere in the browser.
suggested_fix: Render the comment's mentionIds as a 'Notified {name}' chip with pending/acknowledged state.

description: Agent CLI commands accept only Actor IDs or handles: `--assignee me` and `--to Priya` both fail with UNKNOWN_ACTOR. The credential file holds the agent's actorId but no handle, and nothing gives the owner's handle.
expected: `me` resolves to the credential's Actor; an unambiguous display name resolves; or the credential includes the owner's handle.
suggested_fix: Support `me` and exact display-name matching (with AMBIGUOUS_ACTOR on ties); add ownerHandle to the grant file.

description: Mentions render as raw handles such as `@agent-5cf3628a2782edcea198-openai-codex` and `@human-cce56e60-34cd-4653-8f99-35e851214ddf` in comments, History and Activity; on mobile they wrap mid-token.
expected: Mention chips show the Actor's display name ('@Setup agent', '@Priya Raman').
suggested_fix: Resolve handles to display names when rendering mention chips.

description: `commit` with nothing staged returns `GIT_COMMIT_FAILED` with `details:null`; Git's reason ('nothing to commit') is only on stderr, so a JSON-reading agent sees no cause.
expected: details carries git's exit code and last stderr line.
suggested_fix: Include git stderr summary in error details.
